about: Champions are not born; they are forged.
Rule the ring with Undisputed: The Championship Edition, featuring your new cover star Terence “Bud” Crawford.
The Championship Edition includes a packed roster of over 100 fighters, more than 25 venues and extra apparel.
With 4 mega DLC’s -  The WBC Pack; The Iron & Steel Pack; The Mexican Monster Pack and brand-new The Senator Pack the Championship Edition is a true celebration of boxing.
The WBC Pack includes: Jaime Munguia, Regis Prograis, Jesse ‘Bam’ Rodriguez, Dmitry Bivol, Caleb Plant and Julio Cesar Chavez, along with alternate right attire for each.
This also includes The Era Pack, featuring younger versions of Tyson Fury ’09, Canelo Alverez ’11 and Muhammad Ali ’64.
summary: Become Undisputed in the most authentic boxing game to date! Featuring true to life visuals, bone-jarring action, and more licensed boxers than ever before, Undisputed gives you unprecedented control to master every inch of the ring.
